meta.title: Aurora — Effects Platform · Theme 02
meta.description: Silk-gradient skies that drift, breathe, and surge between slides — the second theme on the effects platform.

blocks.text: Silk-gradient skies that drift, breathe, and surge between slides. One engine, many worlds — this is the second.
Slides are plain HTML. Themes are plug-in worlds behind them. The engine drives navigation, reveals, and choreography for all of them.

items.title: Engine
items.text: Slide controller, inputs, chrome, and GSAP flows — shared by every theme.

items.title: Themes
items.text: Cosmos particles and Aurora silk today; lasers, ink, and tiles are next.

items.title: Deck IR
items.text: A JSON schema for decks. Write it by hand — or ingest it from PowerPoint.
A warm violet sunrise — covers and openings.
Cool blue-teal silk for calm content.
A concentrated curtain for one big idea.
Deep and quiet for the serious beat.
A bright surge for the finale.

blocks.text: The composer turns Deck IR into a zero-build page. PowerPoint ingestion lands next — upload, art-direct, ship.
No bundler, no runtime network — **Three.js** and **GSAP** ride along, vendored.
Pick a theme, write HTML or JSON — {ship a universe}.
